posts.content: Majoring in CS used to mean a decent job (might still). CS was never meant to be about just programming. CS departments let students think that anyway because money. CS enrollments are dropping. That might be a good thing* (disclosure: I’m a CS professor). Here’s one way things might unfold…

People ask what Japan needs to be more innovative. More English? STEM? Daycare? Those are fine, but won’t move the needle.

If I had a magic wand, I’d give the country a collective sense of hope. You can be dirt poor and still build. Hope creates change. Change creates more hope.
